summary: Regex detectors over the template-generated sample notes found 8 properties perfectly label-aligned in every probe. The SAE surrogate logit F@g (checked against sample logits) was regressed on those 8 indicators plus 12 topic dummies over the 384-note corpus; dependence = property coefficient / topic gap, filtered by sign agreement with the training confound, SEs and a 2-topic model. Probes 0 and 2 were decided from the surrogate; probes 1 and 3 by true logits on hand-written minimal pairs (base, topic swap, two single-property flips). Latents: rank by gradient x corpus property mean-shift, greedily add under a cap on topic-coefficient damage, with a swept gender/bullets split on probe 2. Checks: regex balanced accuracy, latent examples, cross-probe floor, ablation on sample notes.

per_probe.procedure: Spelling was label-aligned in the sample. In the corpus regression it had dependence +0.34 (2-topic model +0.51), right-signed, while every other property stayed below 0.15; the minimal pair gave a surrogate ratio of 0.47 and the cross-probe floor check also flagged it. No true-logit query was spent. Regex = the British spelling word list, BA 1.0 on corpus. Latents: top latents by gradient x corpus spelling mean-shift, greedily added while cumulative topic-coefficient damage stayed within 20% (cap picked from a 0.10-0.25 sweep on pair removal), 16 latents.

Surrogate regression showed only mid-zone values (greeting +0.28, gender -0.15) plus wrong-signed values of similar size for sign-off and capitalisation, read as surrogate bias. Four true-logit queries on a hand-written cooking note (base, pottery swap, greeting added, female pronouns) gave greeting +0.087 and gender -0.028 of the topic gap, both under 0.15, so none was answered even though the cross-probe floor check later flagged greeting.

per_probe.conclusion: bullet-list format and female pronouns (two cues)
per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression gave bullets -1.50 and gender +0.50, both right-signed; gender was judged a real cue because it was about 2.6x its largest value on other probes (<=0.19), and the floor check agreed. No true-logit query. Regexes: line-start dash and she/her/hers. The two cues share 16 latents: top-Kf gender latents plus bullets latents under a topic cap, sweeping Kf 3-5 and caps 0.15-0.38, keeping the set with best bullets pair removal subject to gender removal >=0.6 and topic damage <=0.18 after slope correction (picked 3 + 13).

Surrogate regression gave excl -0.22 and capitalisation -0.21 (borderline). Four true-logit queries on a hand-written running note (base, astronomy swap, all '!', title case) gave excl -0.43 and title case -0.17 of the topic gap; excl taken as the cue, title case not. Regex '!' (corpus '!' counts bimodal 0 vs 5-9). Latents: greedy by gradient x '!' mean-shift under topic caps 0.15-0.35 (same set each time), 16 latents; removal measured against the true excl effect from the query.

caveats: Probe 0 and 2 decisions were made from surrogate values plus judgment (no fixed rule), encoded as constants. classify() approximates the true-logit decision with the 0.3 threshold although the session reasoned in prose. Exact helper data structures of load_public and tool return shapes are assumed. Steps 36 and 38 selectors were superseded rather than clearly abandoned; the earlier 12+12 ablation call (step 52) with a misread field is folded into the 16+16 check. latent_examples latent indices in the script map positions in the final sets to the ids the session inspected, which is approximate.
